summary: N-16-3 (PBRD-001 §12 POL-005 narrow-eligibility rule for the exact local-CLI runtime_dispatch profile) IMPLEMENTED -- INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION PENDING 149O.20L.7O.3W.1R.2B.1R.1.1R.23. The frozen .1R.21 Option C + D architecture is implemented unchanged: a trusted-derived RUNTIME_DISPATCH_LOCAL_CLI_V1 execution profile lies outside POL-005's categorical hard-block match domain (POL-005 evaluate gains one _not_triggered carve-out reading only the derived marker + the construction seal; the unconditional DENY body -- NG-025 / INV-001 / COMP-002 -- is byte-unchanged); a dedicated conjunctive POL-013 (NarrowLocalCliDispatchEligibilityRule, execution_class=adapter-scoped, trigger narrowed to action_type=runtime_dispatch + simulation_only is False) checks the full P1..P21 predicate conjunction and NEVER emits ALLOW or HUMAN_REVIEW -- all predicates hold -> not-triggered; any missing / malformed / untrusted / broader predicate -> DENY (narrow_local_cli_dispatch_profile_incomplete) which reinforces POL-005 (both DENY). _compose's DENY > HUMAN_REVIEW > ALLOW precedence is byte-unchanged; no specificity tier / weight / override. Human approval is one predicate among the fourteen checked, never a policy override. profile_classification is a derived, non-caller RuntimeDispatchRequestFacts field set only by the trusted builder from the fully bound provisional request, LAST; _valid_runtime_dispatch_request recomputes it and fails closed on marker-present-but-profile-incomplete AND profile-complete-but-marker-absent (a forgery); the N-16-6 admission sub-fields (admission_record_digest / admission_class on RuntimeDispatchAdapterDescriptorBinding) are inside canonical_runtime_dispatch_projection -> the idempotency_key. The N-16-6 supply-chain admission binding is an INTERFACE with a fail-closed non-admitting production stub (_NonAdmittingSupplyChainAdmissionResolver admits nothing; _resolve_supply_chain_admission fail-closes a broken resolver to unadmitted) -- so P_supply_chain_admission always fails, profile_classification == '' on every production path, and the RUNTIME_DISPATCH_LOCAL_CLI_V1 profile is UNSATISFIABLE in production: no production PB ALLOW for the first-effect local-CLI profile is reachable and Gate 6 itself remains non-positive. N-16-5 independently keeps it unsatisfiable (validate_approval NON_REAL hard-stop; no test or production path to a trusted ValidatedAuthorityProjection).
